contributions_exact_reuse.method: Real-centric Envelope Modeling (REM): Manifold Boundary Reconstruction (MBR) uses feature/latent perturbations of VAE real-image reconstructions to make near-real examples; Envelope Estimation (EE) uses a binary/tangency boundary; Cross-Domain Consistency (CDC) aligns a frozen DINO anchor and adapted learner across clean/degraded views (§3, printed pp.229–232).
contributions_exact_reuse.dataset: RealChain’s existing dataset role comprises 14,000 source images from real pools and six text-to-image generator families plus a Seedream image-to-image stratum. No removal or reassessment of the recognized dataset role is authorized.
contributions_exact_reuse.benchmark: Separate ND/CD evaluation of real/fake detection across 50 intended operation chains and seven source/mode strata, with nine independent baselines, balanced accuracy and reported robustness comparisons (§4, Table 5).

cost_Fig7_GPU_hours_per_1000_generated_s.limitation: These are reported generation costs, not necessarily matched generation settings/hardware or a complete detector inference-cost benchmark.

reported_numerical_results_exact_reuse.Fig6_robustness: JPEG, blur, noise and color distortion curves are reported. No unprinted curve-point values have been invented; these perturbations alone do not verify actual platform effects.

arithmetic_receipt.scope: Arithmetic from already-read printed tables, not numerical experiment reproduction. Original source/root notes are unchanged.
arithmetic_receipt.interpretation: REM94.9 and DDA88.0 are consistent with rounding an equal-weight mean across13 displayed ND/CD settings, although the manuscript calls these12 distinct benchmarks. This reconstructs a possible aggregation, not proof of intended weights or statistical replication. Other rows/rounding are retained without repair.
arithmetic_receipt.Table7_RealChain_setting_ambiguity: Column not explicitly labeled ND/CD; main ND/CD arithmetic mean is88.3. The16.4 prose drop cannot be derived directly from these displayed values.

reported_numerical_results_exact_reuse.reported_percent_vs_percentage_points: The paper uses % for gains. Subtracting the printed balanced-accuracy percentages yields 6.9 and 18.4 percentage points; no relative-percent reinterpretation is made.
